question: When did the new judicial system of setting up two courts (Criminal and civil) in each district start?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1772 C.E.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **1772 C.E.** marks the beginning of the new judicial system of setting up two courts (Criminal and Civil) in each district.
 
• This reform was part of the judicial reforms introduced by Warren Hastings, the then Governor-General of India.
 
• The Criminal Court was known as the **Faujdari Adalat**, and the Civil Court was known as the Diwani
